titles: parses the 60-byte GENH header with bounded reads and serves pcm_u8 from start_offset
applies the start_offset and header_size rules: absolute start, 0x800 for header_size 0, and a start inside the header
refuses GENH headers in native order with native exit statuses and unported codecs explicitly
marks a short final packet for the copy refusal and keeps whole-packet inputs copyable
aborts GENH opens, probes and packet reads on the signal
registers a demux-only genh descriptor detected by GENH and a channel count in 1..0xFFFF
uses the sandbox reference built from FFmpeg 946fcce0 without x86 assembly
matches native GENH pcm_u8 copy and decode framecrc, WAV and raw u8 for channels interleaves rates and start rules
matches native GENH output -ss, -t and -frames selections for copy and decode
decodes a short final GENH packet as native does and refuses its stream copy before any output
refuses invalid GENH headers with native exit statuses before any output
refuses GENH inputs native accepts but the port does not mirror before any output

unsupported: GENH codecs other than 13 (pcm_u8): 0, 1, 2, 6, 7, 10, 11, 12, 17 (ADPCM/DPCM) and 3, 4, 5 (always planar since block_align>0; pcm_*_planar is not in PcmCodec)
stream copy of an input whose final packet is short (native flags it KEY|CORRUPT, F=0x3); decoding it is supported
start_offset at or past EOF (native's avio_skip fails silently and demuxes from byte 60)

notes: Setup: sandbox Node was v22.23.5 and bootstrap requires Node 24+, so Node v24.22.3 was installed from nodejs.org (sha256-checked) into /opt/node24. Bootstrap (npm, submodule, reference) took 4m26s; the baseline typecheck, lint, boundaries and registry tests took 1m27s and passed (17 registry tests).

Rate 0: native accepts the header and then fails to open the pcm_u8 decoder and stream copy with AVERROR(EINVAL). The port refuses it in open() with the Linux value 234, and the test expects native's host value (256 - os.constants.errno.EINVAL) & 255.

Native probes in the sandbox: 5 channels (unspecified layout) show '5.0' in framecrc for copy and for decode, and the port matches. A start inside the header (for example 16) makes header bytes into samples (avio_skip seeks back), and the port mirrors it. A header_size-0 start of 0x800 past EOF makes native demux from byte 60, which the port refuses.

Codec 0 (ADPCM PSX): native stream copy succeeds, but its decode fails with 183 ('Decoder requires channel layout to be set'). Codec 4 with interleave 100: native decodes and copies as pcm_s16le_planar (status 0). Both are refused here.
No linux-gated cases. macOS arm64 parity was not run in this sandbox.
